## Problem

What user or security problem does this solve?

## Proposed API or behavior

Show the smallest useful interface or behavior change.

## Security analysis

Explain how the change avoids origin reflection, cache poisoning, preflight
confusion, credential exposure, or downgrade behavior.

## Alternatives considered

What existing API or workaround did you try?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Behavior is specified
- [ ] Tests are identified
- [ ] Documentation impact is identified
